action_items: No fixes required. All 3 new items verified working end-to-end.

Informational only: backend runs with uvicorn --reload (WatchFiles) and reloads whenever files under /app/backend (including /app/backend/tests/) change. During one test run, a manifested-with-testimony doc created inside a pytest run momentarily disappeared from Mongo right after the reload cycle triggered by creating the test file, then reappeared/was creatable again minutes later via direct curl with no issue. This looks like a timing artifact of the dev --reload workflow rather than a real data-loss bug (re-verified the same create->ritual->manifested->wall flow via curl afterward and it persisted correctly across multiple checks with delays). Not something to fix in server.py; just noting for the next testing agent in case reload timing causes transient flakiness in rapid test-then-verify sequences.

backend PATCH /api/profile correctly accepts partial updates for streak_reminder_enabled/streak_reminder_time independently (verified time-only PATCH doesn't reset enabled flag, and vice versa).

GET /api/community/wall query correctly scopes to {is_public: True, status: 'manifested'} and returns all fields needed by the new graphical DetailPanel (max_streak, streak_count, current_day, fasting_enabled, testimony, moon_phase_at_start, donated) — no changes needed.
